items.title: Sweet Candy Style
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Show off your love of a sweet style with this fun skin pack! These skins are themed around popular candies, like Candy Canes and Sweet Tarts! What's your favorite candy?

- 12 Sweet Skins!
- Candy-themed!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Anime Agents
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Suit up! It's time to go undercover. The team needs you!

- 10 Agent Skins!
- Perfect for any secret mission
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Trendy Mobs
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
These mobs are looking good and they know it! Show off your style today!

- 10 Trendy Mobs!
- Mobs included:
* Creeper
* Enderman
* Fox
* Panda
* Skeleton
* Slime
* Spider
* Strider
* Wither Skeleton
* Zombie

- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Trendy Teen Style 2021
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Make sure to wear your sunglasses and expensive outfit, because the trendy style teens are in the town!
Stay cool with these friends and don't be late to the fashion show!

+ 12 trendy style skins!
+ 1 extra FREE skin!
+ By Senior Studios & Lune!

items.title: Mobs In Suits
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Meet the coolest mobs in suits and join their team, today!
Whether you wish to be classy, trendy or cool-looking, this new style will be perfect!

+ 6 skins, taking your favourite mobs to the next level!
+ 1 FREE skin included!
+ By Senior Labs & Senior Studios!

items.title: Rainbow Puffs
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Look at these adorable cloud pets! It will never be a dull gloomy day with one of these by your side. They are colorful and puffy and love to play! Which will you choose?

items.title: Craftable Millionaire Mansions
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Craft GIANT millionaire mansions in this map! Survive in style by gathering a small number of supplies to craft mega mansions!

+ 10 millionaire mansions
+ All craftable

items.title: SKYBLOCK LUCKY BLOCK
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
SKYBLOCK & LUCKY BLOCK

Lucky blocks add a fun new twist to skyblock! Random loot!

items.title: Ninja Adventures
items.creator: Ninja Block
items.description:
Live in a world where you are a ninja. Defeat dragons and creatures with powers and abilities of a true shinobi.

- Open World
- 3 temples with different bosses.
- Grappling hook
- Shuriken
- Ninja suit
- Smoke bomb
- By Irium Studio

items.title: Life in Hawaii
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description: Welcome to Hawaii, an island state with beautiful scenery and fascinating history. Take in the tropical sun. Or, take a scenic tour of the capital city of Honolulu and learn about popular destinations and landmarks. Explore the vast 3000x3000 block terrain using 19 different vehicles.

items.title: Plane Crash Survival
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you ever wondered what it is like being on your own? You have just survived a plane crash, but this is only the begging. If you like being challenged, then this is the perfect scenario for you. 

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Skyblock Planets
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Want a skyblock experience with more than before? Then stop looking because you're at the right spot! This map includes everything the original has, but more! With more challenges and different dimensions. It's much more difficult. Are you up for the challenge?


+ 15 different Islands!
+ Custom Nether and End
+ Up to 40 challenges

- By Orbital Studios And 4KS Studios

items.title: Cartoon Pirates
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to be a pirate? It's your time to be one and put those desires aside; explore the islands with these amazing animated pirate skins and go in search of hidden treasure!

- 10 pirate skins
- 1 totally free skin
- Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Fall Time Hoodies
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Tis the season to wear hoodies! Nothing is more comforting than a warm and soft hoodie to get you through Fall. Put on a sweater and go hang out with some friends and family! Don't let the cold stop you from a wonderful season full of fun.

items.title: Color Derps
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: It's time to be colorful and goofy! Rainbows and blue skies are so beautiful. Show off your love of colorful things and all things derpy with one of these skins!

items.title: Thrift Shop
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Try new fashion senses on any budget! Everyone can be well dressed in this city no matter their wealth. Try to be unique in your style and find your true personality! Be free with your fashion style and impress everyone. Get ready for a new experience and meet excellent people!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Gamer Mobs 2 HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Gamer mobs are back but in new styles! Be a cute pink axolotl, cunning fox, calm panda, and more. Be sure to get on your headset and call for backup when using these fun skins. 

+ 11 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Sea Lion Family
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
What’s better than sea lion friends? Sea Lion Family! Play as mom or dad, kids or baby, or even express your inner boomer and play as grandpa! The whole family is invited!

+ Includes 6 boomcredible skins!

items.title: Modern House: Mountain!
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Enjoy the millionarie lifestyle in the ultimate modern house survival base!
Explore the world with your helicopter or ride around the lake on the jetski.
This secret mountain base includes 60+ pieces of furniture, custom animals and vehicles.

+Includes 3 skins
+By Voxelblocks

items.title: Classic Teens
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Take a step back in time with Classic Teens! Choose from 10 different teen skins, each with unique and cool outfits. Find a look that is right for you!

items.title: Extreme Autumn Fest
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Feel the fresh autumn breeze on this festive night! Everyone is celebrating the entrance into a new season wearing comfy clothes and having some hot drinks. Stay in the woods among your friends and listen to the soft music playing in the background while relaxing in front of a bonfire. Can this be the perfect moment?

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Craftable Furniture
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
Craft, place, and move furniture like any other block in the game. Decorate your gaming setup, house, or mansion with all the furniture you can think of!

+ 472 Craftable Furniture Variants
+ 34 Driveable Vehicle Variants
+ Drivable shopping cart
+ 35 Custom modded blocks
+ Full city build

items.title: Lucky Block Factory
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: A giant factory full of giant lucky blocks, explore this incredible build and find all its secrets!

items.title: Creepy Derps
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These creepy derps are ready to play! Well sort of, they are kind of confused about frightening you and being derpy. I say, why not both! Enjoy these funny looking skins!

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug
